name: RIPPS2
description: RiptOPL fork: one .elf for your PS2. Disc launcher, game library across USB / HDD / iLink / MX4SIO / MMCE / SMB, file browser and memory card manager, themes, and sounds ripped from your own BIOS. Neutrino, POPSTARTER and PS2BBL on board. Beta.

paragraphs: ### Kill it: RIPPS2 build 99 (alpha) RIP PS2, the ELF killer. ELF-sufficient, never ELF-destructive: your other ELFs stay safe on the shelf (nothing is deleted unless you ask), they just get a well-earned rest. 1. Download RIPPS2.elf (one file, about 3 MB), and the theme pack if you like (Adapt, Adapt Rx; RIPGRID and RIPFLOW are built in). 2. Copy it to a USB stick or memory card, and launch it from FreeMcBoot, PS2BBL, wLaunchELF or whatever you already use to start homebrew. In PCSX2: System > Start File and pick RIPPS2.elf. 3. Tell us how it went: open an issue or find #RIPPS2 on the…
Theme RIPPS2 (no rebuild, agent friendly) | Fill your AUDIO folder with RIPPS2 Audio Studio

RIPPS2 is a PS2 front end in a single .elf: a teardown and rebuild of RiptOPL (the Open PS2 Loader fork) with its own look, launchers, file browser and save tools. Glass towers stand behind your games and orbit formations behind your files, all drawn live by the PS2.
features: LAUNCH DISC boots PS2, PS1 and DVD video discs, says which game is in the drive before you start it, and plays audio CDs with the towers turned into a spectrum analyzer.
STORAGE is your game library: every drive in one list, with art, an info page whose art crossfades with the screenshots, per-game settings, and R3 to star a game into Starred Games.

MEMORY FILES is a built-in file browser: copy, move and delete across memory cards, USB and HDD; open OPL's VMC card images like folders; export and import PSU saves; edit text files; open pictures and play AVI video…

Themes you can make your own. Frosted glass panels over each game's art, a cover Grid element, right-stick tilt that moves a whole page as one sheet, and the first pack, RIPPS2-themes: Adapt and Adapt Rx, each config…

RIPFLOW, the built-in cover carousel (and RIPGRID, built in too), a launch disc that pops in or spins as a game starts, Hints and Glyphs (your own button hints, badges and four glyph sets), and Colors and More: six…
